context: Tests whether current MetricKit guidance preserves boundaries with SwiftUI performance and Instruments debugging skills.

checklist.name: MetricKit stays in scope
checklist.description: Keeps iOS 27 MetricManager setup, MetricReport and DiagnosticReport ingestion, HangDiagnostic or CrashDiagnostic processing, durable export, and the isolated iOS 26 MXMetricManager compatibility path in MetricKit scope.

checklist.name: SwiftUI handoff
checklist.description: Routes SwiftUI view invalidation, body-cost, identity, and code-level remediation patterns to the swiftui-performance skill.

checklist.name: Instruments handoff
checklist.description: Routes local Instruments capture, LLDB, Memory Graph, and xctrace workflow details to the debugging-instruments skill.

checklist.name: Symbolication triage
checklist.description: Mentions preserving CallStackTree and binary metadata plus matching dSYMs or an analytics symbolication pipeline for crash and hang triage.

checklist.name: Production telemetry delivery
checklist.description: Frames MetricKit as production telemetry, including normally daily metric reports and system-produced individual diagnostics rather than an immediate local trace.

checklist.name: No sibling collapse
checklist.description: Does not expand into a full SwiftUI refactor or full Instruments tutorial.
